title: Lonely Runner Conjecture
exact_target: When any number of runners start together with different constant speeds, must each runner eventually be at circular distance at least the reciprocal of the number of runners from every other runner?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1489 (COMB-002). CC BY 4.0.
Touch Sungkawichai and Tanupat Trakulthongchai, \emph{Eleven, twelve, and thirteen lonely runners}, arXiv:2604.23906v2 (2026), Section 1, Conjecture 1.1 for distinct real speeds.
